CREATE TABLE "public"."recurring_invoice_items" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "scheduleId" text NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recurring_invoice_occurrences" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "failureCode" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "invoiceId" text,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "scheduleId" text NOT NULL,
  "scheduledFor" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "recurring_invoice_occurrences_status_check_4ed35ce9" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'GENERATED', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recurring_invoice_schedules" (
  "autoIssue" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "clientId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "dueDateOffsetDays" int4 DEFAULT 14 NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamptz,
  "frequency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "interval" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "lastRunAt" timestamptz,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "nextRunAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "recurring_invoice_schedules_frequency_check_b3f9f2fe" CHECK ("frequency" IN ('WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'YEARLY')),
  CONSTRAINT "recurring_invoice_schedules_status_check_e63cd711" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recurring_schedule_events" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "details" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "scheduleId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "recurring_schedule_events_action_check_215e4b7d" CHECK ("action" IN ('CREATED', 'UPDATED', 'PAUSED', 'RESUMED', 'CANCELLED', 'OCCURRENCE_GENERATED', 'AUTO_ISSUED', 'GENERATION_FAILED', 'RETRIED'))
)
